values.meaning: Empowered Damage against enemies below 30% max health
health threshold below which Empowered Damage applies
delay from end of cast time until blink and targetability return
values.binNote: The bin has no field for this post-cast blink delay; it is not present anywhere in the sheet's Evelynn R rows.

mechanics.claim: Evelynn becomes untargetable at the start of the cast time and unleashes her lashers in a cone dealing magic damage to enemies struck within.
mechanics.quote: becoming {{tip|untargetable}} at the start of the cast time and then unleashing her lashers in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies struck within

mechanics.claim: After 0.5 seconds from end of cast, she blinks 700 units backwards and becomes targetable again.
mechanics.quote: she {{tip|blink|blinks}} 700 units in the opposite direction and becomes targetable again

mechanics.claim: Last Caress deals 240% damage against enemies below 30% of their maximum health.
mechanics.quote: ''Last Caress'' is empowered to deal {{ccs|240% damage|magic}} against enemies below {{as|{{sti|health|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}

mechanics.claim: Last Caress can be buffered during Empowered Whiplash.
mechanics.quote: ''Last Caress'' can be buffered during {{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn}}

mechanics.claim: Last Caress can be blocked by spell shields.
